includes: The learning space on your membership days
Daily goals with an academic coach, plus weekly and monthly goals
A note home every day with goals, grades, and missing work
membership.guarantee: If RadAcad isn’t the right fit, we’ll refund your first month of membership. Just let us know.

close.name: Close support
close.desc: Check-ins every hour on every membership day, for high schoolers who need more structure.

checkin.name: Weekly check-in session
checkin.desc: One 30-minute session a week with a coach to plan the week and review what’s due.

coaching.name: One-on-one coaching or tutoring
coaching.desc: One session a week with a coach or tutor, $650 a month. Add more sessions for more support.

subject.name: Single subject class
subject.desc: A full class in one subject, built around your student. Meets three hours a week, all year.

smallGroup.name: Small group class
smallGroup.desc: Classes with other students, PE included. Two 90-minute sessions a week, billed by the semester.

icl.name: ICL Academy
icl.desc: ICL Academy is a RadAcad partner school. Your student takes ICL courses here, with a coach keeping them on track.

live.name: Full week + ICL live
live.desc: Full-week membership plus full-time live ICL Academy enrollment.

async.name: Full week + ICL async
async.desc: Full-week membership plus full-time self-paced ICL Academy enrollment.

icl.janNote: January 2027 starts pay five payments, January through May, and stay at RadAcad through June 15 for capstone projects, portfolio websites, and field days.
icl.janGuarantee: January 2027 guarantee: withdraw by January 31 for a full refund, minus the non-refundable ICL deposit.

aeon.name: Premium: full week + Aeon School
aeon.desc: Aeon is a seminar-style partner school aimed at selective college admissions. Aeon tuition is paid by the semester, in advance.

presets.name: Two-day membership
presets.built: Up to two days a week

presets.name: Online school coaching
presets.built: Two-day membership + one coaching session a week

presets.name: Full week + coaching
presets.built: Full week + two coaching sessions a week

presets.name: Middle school mix
